notes.title: Dream Fire has arrived on your monitors!
notes.notes:
After 3 years of intense work by myself, without any sponsorship, I finally managed to make this game public!
[b] Dream Fire[/b] is an open world game in which you have all kinds of interesting tasks and you can make the most of this experience. Thus being able to lead a life of survival in the forest where you hunt, cut trees, etc. or to lead a life in an educated civilization where you have friends, your own car, pet, job or why not, both!

[previewyoutube=-N5R2cHYpK4;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]

Unfortunately, it is currently in the Alpha state, because there are still some bugs and the multiplayer is not yet implemented

I'm waiting for you on Dream Fire!
